versions.changelog:
- Added user account management endpoints for viewing API keys, account info, and usage statistics.
- Introduced automatic user registration: user accounts are created on first API key purchase; no separate registration required.
- Distinguished between payment API (fact-api) and user management API (napi-ser) with clear base URLs.
- Updated documentation to include new endpoints: `/user/me` and `/user/my-keys`.
- Description now includes user account and usage management use cases.

iAutopay version 0.1.0

- Initial release of the skill for purchasing API keys from iAutoPay Fact API using USDC on Base Sepolia.
- Supports buying API keys for 1, 7, and 30 day durations with transparent pricing.
- Integrates EIP-3009 off-chain payment authorization in API requests.
- Includes endpoints for server info, buying API keys, USDC transfers, and pricing refresh.
- Provides ready-to-use CLI scripts (Python/TypeScript) for all major endpoints.l
